nl: Write a function `f` that returns the greatest common divisor of two positive i32 values by repeated subtraction (while a != b, replace the larger by the difference) using a loop with phi nodes.

define i32 @f(i32 %a, i32 %b) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %x = phi i32 [ %a, %entry ], [ %x.next, %body ]
  %y = phi i32 [ %b, %entry ], [ %y.next, %body ]
  %ne = icmp ne i32 %x, %y
  br i1 %ne, label %body, label %exit
body:
  %gt = icmp sgt i32 %x, %y
  %xd = sub i32 %x, %y
  %yd = sub i32 %y, %x
  %x.next = select i1 %gt, i32 %xd, i32 %x
  %y.next = select i1 %gt, i32 %y, i32 %yd
  br label %loop
exit:
  ret i32 %x
}
